    """Return explicit primary-unit identities, never a lemma-selected vector."""
    return {

def chart_definition_records() -> tuple[dict, ...]:
    """Primary-source identities for units without a demonstrated native match.

    The full box is contextual evidence, not an explication invented here. A
    lexical unit's POS is deliberately unspecified: an English exponent's POS
    does not prove that every allowable NSM frame has that grammatical type.
    No candidate coordinate or frame participant becomes a bank assertion.
    """
    records = []
    for key, heading, forms, frames in _CHART_BOXES:
        if key in _NATIVE_PRIME_DEFINITIONS:
            continue
        kind = "GRAMMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION" if key in _CHART_CONSTRUCTIONS else "LEXICAL_UNIT"
        records.append(
            {
                "entry_id": f"nsm_chart:v20:{key}",
                "unit_id": f"nsm:v20:{key}",
                "lemma": _CHART_LEMMAS.get(key, key),
                "pos": "nsm_construction" if key in _CHART_CONSTRUCTIONS else "nsm_lexical_unit",
                "definition": f"NSM v20 {kind.lower().replace('_', ' ')} {heading.replace(chr(10), '')}. "
                "The source identifies this elementary meaning through its exponent forms and allowable frames; "
                "these frames are preserved as context, not asserted as the unit's own bank values.",
                "definition_kind": kind,
                "chart_heading": heading,
                "forms": tuple(forms),
                "frame_text": frames,
                "source_reference": dict(SOURCE),
                "chart_notes": CHART_NOTES,
                "frames_are": "COMBINATORIAL_NOT_OWN_WORD_ASSIGNMENTS",
            }
        )
    return tuple(records)

import pytest

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "text",
    [

        "He is a thing.",
        "He is an organism.",
        "He is an animal.",
        "He is a person.",
        "He is happy.",
        "He studies helium.",
        "He discusses gas.",
        "He is not a gas.",
        "He is an inert gas?",
    ],
)
def test_broad_ancestor_or_unasserted_type_cannot_veto_person_reference(encoder, text):
    token = encoder.encode(text).tokens[0]
    assert token.lexical_evidence["selected_record"]["entry_id"] == "gse_closed_class:pronoun:he"
    assert token.word_primitives == {"SOMEONE": 1}


def test_exact_native_context_is_consumed_not_dropped_after_pos_challenge(encoder):
    token = encoder.encode("He is an inert gas.").tokens[0]
    evidence = token.lexical_evidence
    assert evidence["selected_record"]["entry_id"] == "wordnet:he:helium.n.01"
    assert evidence["reading_eligibility"]["code"] == "CONTEXTUAL_DEFINITION_SELECTED"
    assert evidence["contextual_grounding"]["code"] == "EXACT_WORDNET_SENSE"
    assert token.pos == "NOUN"  # prevents subsequent pronoun recency binding
    assert token.word_primitives == {k: v for k, v in evidence["selected_record"]["assignments"].items() if v}
    assert evidence["domains"] == encoder.lookup_definition("wordnet:he:helium.n.01")["selected"]["domains"]
    assert evidence["domains"]["WANT"] == [-1, 0, 1]

import pytest

from GSE.api import GSEEncoder
from GSE.symbolic import emit_contract, evaluate_tree, from_trace, resolve
from GSE.symbolic.expression import Negation
from GSE.symbolic.predicates import Event, RelativeRestriction, Temporal, TypeAssertion
from GSE.symbolic.queries import is_logically_equal_to
from GSE.symbolic.resolution import Coordination, Entity

@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def encoder():
    with GSEEncoder() as instance:
        instance.conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
        yield instance


def compose(encoder, text):
    return evaluate_tree(resolve(from_trace(encoder.encode(text))))


def test_spatial_opposites_reach_query_and_emitted_contract(encoder):
    above = compose(encoder, "The bird is above the tree.")
    below = compose(encoder, "The bird is below the tree.")
    assert isinstance(above, Event) and isinstance(below, Event)
    assert (above.verb, below.verb) == ("above", "below")
    assert above.agent.head.lemma == below.agent.head.lemma == "bird"
    assert above.patient.head.lemma == below.patient.head.lemma == "tree"
    assert not is_logically_equal_to(above, below)
    assert emit_contract(above)["predicate"]["features"]["verb"] == "above"
    assert emit_contract(below)["predicate"]["features"]["verb"] == "below"
    negated = compose(encoder, "The bird is not above the tree.")
    assert isinstance(negated, Negation) and negated.operand.verb == "above"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("linker,anchor", [("before", "dawn"), ("after", "noon"), ("after", "winter")])
def test_native_time_typed_nominal_is_setting_not_patient(encoder, linker, anchor):
    tree = compose(encoder, f"Alice arrived {linker} {anchor}.")
    assert isinstance(tree, Temporal) and tree.conjunction == linker
    assert tree.setting.head.lemma == anchor
    assert isinstance(tree.event, Event) and tree.event.verb == "arrive"
    assert tree.event.agent.head.lemma == "alice" and tree.event.patient is None
    assert emit_contract(tree)["predicate"]["features"]["conjunction"] == linker

def test_coordinated_adjectives_and_of_attachment_modify_one_nominal_head(encoder):
    trace = encoder.encode("The femur is the longest and thickest bone of the human skeleton.")
    assert next(t for t in trace.tokens if t.lemma == "femur").word_primitives.get("BODY") == 1
    tree = evaluate_tree(resolve(from_trace(trace)))
    assert isinstance(tree, TypeAssertion) and tree.entity.head.lemma == "femur"
    assert isinstance(tree.kind, RelativeRestriction)
    modified = tree.kind.head
    assert isinstance(modified, RelativeRestriction) and modified.head.head.lemma == "bone"
    assert isinstance(modified.restriction, TypeAssertion)
    modifiers = modified.restriction.kind
    assert isinstance(modifiers, Coordination) and modifiers.conjunction == "and"
    assert [a.lemma for a in modifiers.members] == ["long", "thick"]

    assert isinstance(of, Event) and of.verb == "of"
    assert of.agent.head.lemma == "bone" and of.patient.head.lemma == "skeleton"

def __init__(self, conn, doc, clause_linkers):

def _native_example_support(self, position, lemma, senses, pos):
        """Make attested non-nominal identities reachable without a POS override.

        Compare the complete sentence construction rather than isolated cue
        words. This deliberately abstains on underspecified or novel uses;
        grammatical role alone, frequency and already-filled banks cannot
        license a definition. Existing nominal type-thread grounding is kept
        separate because noun and verb threads are not comparable types.
        """
        start, end = self._bounds(position, self.sentence_boundaries)
        actual = tuple((t.lemma_.casefold(), t.pos_) for t in self.doc[start + 1 : end])
        witnesses = {}
        for entry_id, sense in senses.items():
            examples = [
                example for example in sense.examples if _native_example_signature(example, lemma, pos) == actual
            ]
            if examples:
                witnesses[entry_id] = {
                    "witness_kind": "WORDNET_NATIVE_EXAMPLE_CONSTRUCTION",
                    "native_synset": sense.synset,
                    "native_examples": examples,
                    "construction_signature": [list(pair) for pair in actual],
                    "eligible_pos": pos,
                    "source_record_id": entry_id,
                }
        return _unique_native_witness(witnesses)
